question: What would you like to talk over while you're here?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “Lately I keep losing track when there are a few little things to do at once. I’ll start getting something ready, then something else catches my attention, and… what was I doing? (small laugh) It’s not that I can’t do the jobs. I like having my bit to do for the walking group. I just don’t like the thought of people waiting on me because I’ve left something unfinished.”
